conclusion.justification: The report explicitly states that the claim is supported by evidence, citing systematic reviews and studies showing that bystander hands-only CPR significantly increases survival compared to no CPR. Therefore, it strongly endorses the claim.
conclusion.label: endorses

report:
The claim is **supported by evidence** — it is not false. Multiple studies and systematic reviews consistently show that bystander CPR, including hands-only (compression-only) CPR, is associated with significantly higher survival after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) compared to no bystander CPR.

A 2026 systematic review covering 72 studies and nearly 3 million OHCA cases found that bystander CPR significantly improved survival: 26% higher odds of survival to hospital admission, 44% higher odds of survival to hospital discharge, and 50% higher odds of favorable neurological survival compared to no CPR. A PubMed-indexed study noted that CPR for OHCA is "associated with higher survival" and examined time-to-bystander-CPR thresholds relative to no bystander CPR. An Emergency Live report citing American Heart Association guidance stated that "doing only chest compressions doubles the chance of survival, compared to doing nothing." A PMC review identified bystander CPR as "the most important factor to improve the survival of OHCAs."

The evidence distinguishing hands-only from conventional CPR is more nuanced — several meta-analyses found no significant difference between compression-only and standard CPR with ventilation, meaning hands-only is at least as effective. But the comparison to *no CPR* is clear-cut: any bystander CPR substantially improves survival. The user's skepticism appears unfounded based on the available literature.

**Sources:**
- https://www.ovid.com/jnls/shockjournal/fulltext/10.1097/shk.0000000000002812~effect-of-bystander-cpr-on-survival-after-out-of-hospital
- https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40015622/
- https://www.emergency-live.com/health-and-safety/survive-an-ohca-the-american-heart-association-revealed-that-hands-only-cpr-increases-survival-rate/
- https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6182861/
